parts.name: Accordion
parts.description: Radix accordion root. Set type="single" for one open item or "multiple" for an array of open items. Native div attributes are forwarded.

props.name: type
props.description: Required state mode. single uses string values; multiple uses string arrays.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled open item value (single) or values (multiple).

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial open item value or values when uncontrolled.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with a string in single mode or a string array in multiple mode.

props.name: collapsible
props.description: In single mode, allow the currently open item to close. Not used in multiple mode.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disable all triggers in this accordion.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Layout and keyboard navigation axis.

props.name: dir
props.description: Text and keyboard direction: ltr or rtl.

props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered inside the component.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes applied to the component’s documented root or control.

props.name: id
props.description: DOM identifier for the rendered element.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render through one child element instead of the default element. The child must forward its ref and accept the supplied props.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the component’s documented DOM element.

parts.name: AccordionItem
parts.description: An accordion item with a stable value unique within its root. Native div attributes are forwarded.

props.name: value
props.description: Stable, non-empty item identifier unique within the accordion.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disable this item’s trigger.

props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered inside the component.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes applied to the component’s documented root or control.

props.name: id
props.description: DOM identifier for the rendered element.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render through one child element instead of the default element. The child must forward its ref and accept the supplied props.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the component’s documented DOM element.

parts.name: AccordionTrigger
parts.description: A native button inside an accordion heading. The component owns its label and chevron layout; asChild is not supported.

props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered inside the component.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the native control.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Native activation handler.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes applied to the component’s documented root or control.

props.name: id
props.description: DOM identifier for the rendered element.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the component’s documented DOM element.

parts.name: AccordionContent
parts.description: Expandable accordion panel with an inner spacing wrapper. Native attributes and ref apply to the outer panel.

props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered inside the component.

props.name: forceMount
props.description: Keep the Radix content mounted for externally managed visibility or animation. The consumer must manage its closed presentation.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes applied to the component’s documented root or control.

props.name: id
props.description: DOM identifier for the rendered element.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the component’s documented DOM element.
